feeds.title: BMC Medical Education
feeds.description: BMC Medical Education welcomes work focused on the training of healthcare professionals across all levels of education --from undergraduate to postgraduate and on to continuing education. Our open access peer-reviewed research covers a range of topics, such as curriculum development, evaluations of performance, assessment of training needs and evidence-based medicine.

feeds.title: Medibuddy
feeds.description: Medibuddy is a medical education initiative which aims to make life easier for junior doctors applying for their training posts. We have assembled a team of doctors who have all secured some of the most competitive jobs in their specialities and are passionate about passing on the tips and preparation methods they used to prepare for interview.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily
feeds.description: Research stories on medical education, residency, teaching hospitals and more.

feeds.title: Medicalopedia
feeds.description: Medicalopedia is a health blog covering new websites, medical discoveries, gadgets, reference articles, medical apps, health & fitness tips.

feeds.title: Broome Docs
feeds.description: Welcome to Broome Docs, this site is intended to provide a single source of up-to-date educational material for country doctors. The aim of this site is to provide a single place for all you time-poor doctors to come and get quality education, clinical tips and interact with one another without having to search all over the internet.

feeds.title: Provider Practice Essentials Blog
feeds.description: Learn about what Provider Practice Essentials is up to and various medical topics on our blog. Our mission is to provide resources, education, and other services necessary to further the delivery of healthcare by providers in a healthcare setting. This blog is one of those resources.

feeds.title: DrBeen
feeds.description: Study up on critical medical concepts and current health trends with these articles from DrBeen. Browse by categories focusing on specific topics to know more. DrBeen is a medical learning platform dedicated to helping boost the career of working professionals like doctors, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, registered nurses, and more.

feeds.title: Medical eStudy
feeds.description: Medical eStudy is a platform dedicated to compiling and publishing, relevant medical studies content and assisting NCLEX Students as well as medical professionals in their search for accurate information. Follow the latest articles and posts to stay informed and inspired.

feeds.title: Medical Topics
feeds.description: What are Some of the Important Health Issues to be Aware of? Get all the information you need.

feeds.title: Scope Blog » Medical Education
feeds.description: Scope is an award-winning blog founded in 2009 and produced by the Stanford University School of Medicine. If you're curious about the latest advances in medicine and health and enjoy compelling, fresh and easily digestible news and features, then we've got just the thing. We're aiming to reach you — whether you're an award-winning scientist or first-year med student, a biotech enthusiast or a health-conscious reader.

feeds.title: PSP Education Blog
feeds.description: Covers the latest details about MBBS Admission in Russia, China, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Georgia & Tajikistan for becoming a successful Doctor. The MBBS Abroad are continuously striving to satisfy our students to serve them with the best quality education by providing them authorized and complete service for the entire duration of their course.

feeds.title: Gamsat Review Blog
feeds.description: The Gamsat Review Blog is run by Dr Peter Griffiths and contains advice for students sitting the GAMSAT test - the Graduate Medical School Admissions Test for entry to medicine and dental graduate entry courses. Hello I'm Dr Peter Griffiths. I took GAMSAT for myself back in 2005, passing first time and scoring in the top 10%. Since then as well as working as a doctor I've helped countless students pass the test.

feeds.title: EasyLearnMedical
feeds.description: I am Dr. Aparna Vasudevan. I am here to teach you to learn medical terms through a simple step by step process. I decided to open a blog for medical professionals about basic medical terminologies through which those who wish to learn the basics of medical terms and human anatomy may also utilize this as a platform.

feeds.title: Martin Verbic Blog
feeds.description: I'm a medical student from Slovenia. This is where I share my thoughts, stories and ideas.

feeds.title: History of Vaccines Blog
feeds.description: The History of Vaccines is an award-winning informational, educational website created by The College of Physicians of Philadelphia, one of the oldest medical societies in the United States.The blog aims to increase public knowledge and understanding of the ways in which vaccines, toxoids, and passive immunization work, how they have been developed, and the role they have played in the improvement.

feeds.title: KevinMD.com » Education
feeds.description: Dr. Kevin Pho is a board-certified internal medicine physician and founder of KevinMD.com, which Forbes called a 'must-read health blog.' His opinion pieces highlight the challenges real-world doctors face, ranging from the primary care shortage to the epidemic of physician burnout. His dual perspectives as a practicing physician and a health care social media leader highlight his unique social media journey.

feeds.title: ICE Blog
feeds.description: The ICE blog promotes discussion among Clinician Educators from around the world, archiving a variety of educational resources. We welcome anyone with an interest in health professions education.

feeds.title: Medical Dialogues
feeds.description: At Medical Dialogues, we are a team of young professionals strongly advocating of the transparency in the medical sector through the free flow of medical information, health and medical education news.

feeds.title: Indiana University School of Medicine Blog
feeds.description: A national leader in medical research and education, with more than 60 academic departments and specialty divisions across nine campuses statewide.

feeds.title: Nursing Note
feeds.description: Nursing Note is a Nursing Educational Platform. Here we will provide you only Important Notes, that will help you very much in the nursing profession & education. We're dedicated to providing you with the best of Nursing, with a focus on dependability and This website is all about Nursing-related notes & suggestions for ANM, GNM, B. sc, and other medical persons.

feeds.title: Med-Challenger Blog
feeds.description: Med-Challenger Medical Education Blog - medical education news, board review product reviews, board review tips, free board questions, user tutorials...
